title: LocalEvaluationResult
description: Sub-scores from the local OpenAI VLM evaluator for a single (prompt_pair_id, user_prompt_id, sample_id) cell.

edit_correctness.description: How well the edit follows the intermediate prompt (0=ignored, 1=exact match).

garment_transfer_correctness.description: Accuracy of garment placement and transfer (0=wrong, 1=natural fit).

preservation.description: How well identity and background are preserved (0=unrecognizable, 1=unchanged).

artifact_penalty.description: Degree of visible artifacts (0=clean, 1=severe artifacts). Higher is worse.
